proposed_widenings.name: revert_form
proposed_widenings.justification: On a failed save, a shape-shifted creature reverts to its true form. No v4 atom exists for forced form reversion — the inverse of transform_target. end_ongoing_spells is too broad (ends all spells of a level range) and does not cover wild shape or non-spell shape-shifting. A dedicated revert_form atom is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if the creature is shape-shifted (as a result of the Polymorph spell, for example), it reverts to its true form

proposed_widenings.name: suppress_shape_change
proposed_widenings.justification: After reverting, the creature cannot shape-shift again until it leaves the cylinder. This is an area-scoped persistent suppression of a capability (shape-shifting). No v4 atom exists for suppressing form-change. The Condition type does not include a 'no shape-shifting' state. The suppression is tied to the area attachment (lifts on exit), which would require either a new Condition with area-exit expiry or a dedicated atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: can't shape-shift until it leaves the Cylinder

proposed_widenings.name: on_creature_ends_turn_in_area
proposed_widenings.justification: Moonbeam's core ongoing threat fires at the END of each creature's turn in the area. The surface has on_attached_turn_start (fires at turn start) but no turn-end variant. Using on_attached_turn_start as a proxy is mechanically inaccurate — turn start and turn end are distinct resolution points. Same gap as Cloudkill.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature also makes this save when... it ends its turn there.

proposed_widenings.name: once_per_turn_dedup on OngoingOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has three ongoing triggers (area moves into creature, creature enters, creature ends turn there) but a creature makes the save at most once per turn. No field on OngoingOperation allows expressing per-turn deduplication across multiple operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes this save only once per turn.

notes: Partial dhall authored (content/moonbeam.dhall). The core mechanic — cylinder area, initialPhase Con save, on_creature_enters_area trigger, upcast scaling (+1d10/slot above 2) — is fully expressible with the current surface. Two operations are encoded (entry save_gate + turn_start proxy for turn_end save_gate), giving a meaningful but incomplete trace. Omitted from the dhall due to Dhall list homogeneity: emit_light (Dim Light fills cylinder) and reposition_attachment (Magic action, 60 ft) — both atoms exist in the surface but cannot share a list with save_gate operations in Dhall. The shape-shift mechanic (revert + suppress) is a secondary conditional effect that requires two new v4 atoms. The turn-end trigger gap is the same surface_widening as Cloudkill. The atom gap from shape-shift mechanics drives the outcome to atom_widening.
